$comment: What Auvyx Builder Pro adds (docs/editions.md). PHP reads generated/editions.php, Auvyx Studio Generated.scala. Templates of a kit not in freeKits, and the ids in proTemplates, are Pro. Site templates are never Pro.

popup.title: Popups
popup.description: Any section as a popup: on load, exit intent, scroll or a link; modal, bar, corner or side panel.

display-rules.title: Display rules
display-rules.description: Show components on archives, categories, search, 404; leave pages out; by audience, role and dates.

form-actions.title: Form actions
form-actions.description: Send visitors to a page after a form, and post every message to a webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n, a CRM).

site-code.title: Site code
site-code.description: Code in the head and footer of every page: analytics, pixels, chat widgets.

custom-code.title: Custom CSS and code
custom-code.description: CSS of your own on any element, and code elements with your HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

role-manager.title: Role manager
role-manager.description: Choose which roles may open Auvyx Studio and change the design.

pro-data.title: More data
pro-data.description: Author, dates, comments, reading time and terms in any heading, text, button or image.

pro-blocks.title: Pro blocks
pro-blocks.description: Popup, flip box, before/after, marquee, countdown, hotspots, sliders, table of contents, share buttons and more.

pro-templates.title: Every section kit
pro-templates.description: All the ready-made section kits: stores, hotels, schools, real estate and more.
